item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: India v Pakistan clash in Colombo breaks viewership records, becomes most watched match in tournament history
item.description: The recent India v Pakistan T20 World Cup 2026 game, which was played in Colombo on February 15, has broken all viewership records. India defeated Pakistan by 61 runs in a one-sided contest. Ishan Kishan won the Player of the Match for his 77-run knock, while Jasprit Bumrah and Varun Chakaravarthy starred with the ball. item.title: Suryakumar, Harmanpreet, Mandhana, Hardik set to feature for India in cricket in Asian Games 2026- Report
item.description: Ahead of the upcoming 2026 Asian Games that will be held in Japan, it has been reported that the BCCI is taking the men’s and women’s cricket events at the Games seriously and hence has sent across the names of all major cricketers in both categories to the Indian Olympic Association (IOA). The Asian Games will be held in Japan's Aichi and Nagoya prefectures from September 19 to October 4, 2026. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: 'Blessing Muzarabani would’ve got 20 crores, if IPL auction was held after the World Cup’- Mohammad Kaif
item.description: Zimbabwean fast bowler Blessing Muzarabani may have gotten bids of over INR 20 crore if the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026 auction had been held after the ICC Men's T20 World Cup, according to former Indian cricketer Mohammad Kaif. With nine wickets at an average of 7.88 and an economy rate of 5.91 in three group-stage games, Muzarabani has been in outstanding form. item.title: “ECB need to act fast”- Michael Vaughan on reports of IPL owned teams to skip Pakistan players in upcoming The Hundred auction
item.description: Former England captain Michael Vaughan has commented on speculations that Pakistan players may be ignored in this year's The Hundred, with the four teams associated with the Indian Premier League unlikely to select them in next month's auction. The Hundred's new season, which runs from July 21 to August 16, 2026, follows substantial private investment that has significantly increased player pay. item.description: Former England captain Alastair Cook has doubted whether the Indian and Pakistani players are not shaking hands for the sake of it and talking and mingling behind closed doors in the ongoing T20 World Cup 2026. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: “He’s going to deliver”- Morne Morkel says India has no plans to drop Abhishek Sharma despite 3 ducks
item.description: Team India is prepping for the T20 World Cup 2026 Super 8s stage, as they have been placed in Group 1 with West Indies, Zimbabwe, and South Africa. item.title: WATCH: “I should have a whole web series,” Virender Sehwag mocks Sahibzada Farhan's documentary for hitting sixes off Bumrah
item.description: Not the one to mince his words, legendary India opener Virender Sehwag has taken a brutal swipe at Pakistan batter Sahibzada Farhan over the latter’s much-talked-about documentary. item.description: The International Cricket Council (ICC) rejected Bangladesh’s plea to relocate their T20 World Cup 2026 matches to Sri Lanka last month. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: WATCH – “Jo Bole So Nihaal…,” Abhishek Sharma delivers fiery pep talk ahead of India’s Super 8 opener
item.description: Heading into the T20 World Cup 2026, Abhishek Sharma was expected to be India's destroyer-in-chief. However, the left-handed opener failed to live up to the hype, bagging three consecutive ducks in the group-stage of the tournament. While Abhishek missed India’s Group A clash against Namibia due to stomach infection and fever, he couldn’t trouble scorers in the matches against USA, Pakistan and Netherlands. item.description: Babar Azam, who was dropped from Pakistan’s T20I squad last year for his slow strike rate, is currently featuring in the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026 and the right-hander has once again come under intense scrutiny for his turtle-paced approach.
